liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Dark Star** (1 review): Reviewer notes Dark Star, Alligator, Feed Back and the closer follow Railroading, a sequence never seen on other setlists [4]

## Setlist highlights

- **Let It Be Me**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [7]
- **Silver Threads**: rare: 3 archived performances [7]
- **Cathy's Clown**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [7]
- **Slewfoot**: earliest performance in the archive; rare: 9 archived performances [7]
- **Games People Play//**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [7]
- **Green Green Grass Of Home**: rare: 8 archived performances [7]
- **Tiger By The Tail//**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [7]
- **I've Just Seen A Face**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [7]
- Earliest performances in the archive: Mama Tried, The Race Is On [7]

## The recordings

- **gd1969-06-11.145953.aud.flac1644** (recommended): audience recording; 19 songs; 92 min; rated 0.4/5 by 5 [1]

## Around the show

- Reviewer says the posted recording's contents don't match the listed June 11 setlist, which seems copied from Deadbase [2]
- Reviewer identifies the recording as the early show at Fillmore East on 1969-09-27, not this California Hall date [3]
- Reviewer says no recording of this June 11 show is known, and the posted tape is from Fillmore on September 27, 1969 [6]
- Reviewer says the recording isn't from this show, and wonders whether a fuller 6/11/69 tape exists but never surfaced [4]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1969-06-11.145953.aud.flac1644**: taped by Unknown; source: Lineage: Master Audience Reel @ 3.75 ips>Reel>A>Reel>A>A>A [1]. Also: Lineage: master audience reel at 3.75 ips, through several analog and digital generations of copies; Transfer used Maxell XLII tape, Nakamichi DR-2 deck, Edirol FA-66 interface, Wavelab, R8Brain and CD-Wave, saved as FLAC 16/44.1 [1]
